text_block_list.text:
It's a new year, and the beginning of
Narita
Brian's classic year.
...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Do you have a kotatsu?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I need one if I'm going to watch New
Year's TV
shows. Oh, and oranges, too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yes, it really is.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I set up my office with a kotatsu—a

blanket-skirted table with a heater

underneath—and oranges, just as Narita
Brian
requested.

...She's currently warming her legs under
said
kotatsu.
Turn on the TV. It's about to start.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! Thanks for tuning in to
the first
"Race Bulletin" of the New Year!
text_block_list.name: TV Show Host

text_block_list.text:
Numerous racers had remarkable
performances
last year, including Rice
Shower, who brought
Мэдзиро МакКуин's
spring winning streak to a halt!
text_block_list.name: TV Show Commentator

text_block_list.text:
And those special three gave us a
thrilling
competition for the Classic
Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: TV Show Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Yes! And one among them became the
face to
represent the whole year...
text_block_list.name: TV Show Host

text_block_list.text:
That's right! Please welcome the
Umamusume of
the Year... Biwa
Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: TV Show Announcer

text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's really her!
text_block_list.name: TV Show Host

text_block_list.text: Haha... Hello.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So, Бива Хаяхидэ, I hear that Narita
Brian, who
made her debut this past
year, is your little sister.
Is that true?
text_block_list.name: TV Show Announcer

text_block_list.text:
That's right. My sister is an incredibly
strong
racer. Thanks to her, it's been a
year of
heightened focus for me as well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I was only able to take the Kikuka Sho in
the
Classic Triple Crown tour, but...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I think she has the potential to be Triple
Crown
Champion.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Murmer...
Hm.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: We're out of oranges. I'll go get some.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle!
Excuse me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Amazon?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I just heard the news. Sounds like you're
going on
the Triple Crown tour, eh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What of it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'll be on the Tiara tour—the Oka Sho,
Japanese
Oaks, and Shuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...You know, I realized something when I
saw you
in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...That honestly, in my current state, I
don't think
I could win against you just
yet.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: So... I'll do it next year!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take one year to polish myself
up! I'll
take the Triple Tiara and get
stronger!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Then, I want you to face me one-on-one
at the
Arima Kinen at the end of the
year! You better
not run away!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You aim for the three crowns and I'll
take the
three tiaras. Then we'll see who
shines brighter!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Well, that's all. Later.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Amazon, wait.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Whoosh... Whap!
What's this? An orange?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: A parting gift. Take it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: It should be an exciting race.

Was that because oranges are packed with
nutrition?

text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: It should be an exciting race.

Was that because oranges are packed with
nutrition?

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I saw it in her eyes. She's really
planning
on getting stronger and
bringing the heat.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I have high hopes for when we face off
for real.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Suppose we should do some training then.

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Can we leave the kotatsu out?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That's exactly right. You need nutrients
in order
to compete.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And the two of us are... competing, after
all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: That's a good attitude to have.

text_block_list.text:
...I'm just repeating what my big sis said
once.
They're not my own words.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Heh. I wouldn't call that enough to make
a
difference.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Tell me, what kind of strategy do you
have in
mind for me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What kind of training will ensure I can
face off
against Ama after she takes the
three tiaras?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And so, I get an early start to this year's
race
strategizing with a battle-hungry
Нарита Брайан.

Нарита Брайан wastes no time getting back
under
the kotatsu and eating oranges.

I decide to leave the kotatsu out over
New Year's
as a reward for training.
